steps.en: Once LTA returns the owner, the notice goes to the first reminder stage
steps.id: Setelah LTA mengembalikan data owner, notice masuk ke tahap reminder pertama

steps.en: A daily job revives expired suspensions and leaves paid notices alone
steps.id: Job harian me-revive suspension yang habis dan tidak menyentuh notice yang sudah dibayar

steps.en: Reminders one to three are prepared in order, but only on a manual trigger
steps.id: Reminder satu sampai tiga disiapkan berurutan, tapi hanya lewat pemicu manual
steps.why_en: The three-reminder sequence exists, but the daily scheduler no longer starts letter generation; staff must trigger it by hand.
steps.why_id: Urutan tiga reminder ada, tapi scheduler harian tidak lagi memulai pembuatan letter; staf harus memicunya manual.

steps.en: Reminder letters should reach the owner, but upload is off in production settings
steps.id: Surat reminder seharusnya sampai ke pemilik, tapi upload dimatikan di pengaturan produksi
steps.why_en: Production settings switch off the upload of reminder letters, and no SMS or email is sent for these vehicles.
steps.why_id: Pengaturan produksi mematikan upload surat reminder, dan tidak ada SMS atau email untuk kendaraan ini.

steps.en: After the third reminder the notice is held and does not move toward court
steps.id: Setelah reminder ketiga notice ditahan dan tidak bergerak ke court
steps.why_en: A repeating suspension holds the notice for good, and the rule uses two different checks.
steps.why_id: Notice ditahan oleh suspension berulang sehingga tidak pernah maju, dan aturan penahanan memakai dua pengecekan berbeda untuk kendaraan ini.
